Elias smiled, tucking the letter into his coat, knowing he’d write back tomorrow to tell her she’d found her way to someone who’d seen every inch of that horizon she’d dreamed of.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市浸在淡淡的夜雾里，柏油路面还留着白日余温散后的凉意，街边的梧桐叶被风卷着打了个旋，落在空无一人的公交站台旁。远处的便利店亮着暖黄的灯，值夜班的店员趴在柜台上打盹，偶尔有晚归的代驾骑着电动车掠过，尾灯拖出一道转瞬即逝的红线。高楼的窗只剩零星几盏亮着，像散落在黑丝绒上的碎钻，整座城市还在沉睡，连车流声都压得很低，生怕惊扰了快要破晓的梦。", "w03": "• Recursion is when you take a big, complicated problem and split it into smaller, identical copies of the same problem.\n• You keep splitting the problem until you reach a tiny, super simple problem that you can answer right away, no more splitting needed.\n• Then you work your way back up, combining those small answers to solve the original big problem step by step."}
